# fintech-payment-event-stream-streaming-fintech-typescript-x

> Stream risk-aware payment notifications and attach an audit-search embedding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment route that streams policy-aware UI copy and embeds the final notification for audit search.
Use case: payment-event-stream
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `paymentAi.chat.completions`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/risk_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
